about: The 32 VBR files blocked in Phase 4.1: why the app cannot seek them, and two validated recoveries. Evidence only; the recovered files stay in local scratch storage (rights: modified copies may not be hosted without permission). docs/audio/vbr-recovery-phase-4-3-2026-10-18.md
player: expo-audio 57.0.5: Android androidx.media3 1.9.0 ProgressiveMediaSource with default Mp3Extractor flags (SeekParameters.EXACT); iOS AVPlayer seek(to:) with zero tolerance (not tested).

method.realExtractor: audit/SeekProbe (scratch): the real media3 1.9.0 Mp3Extractor run on the JVM; error = true start of the first frame kept (label >= target) minus target
method.mllt: audit/vbr_recover.py mllt: ID3v2 MLLT (one reference per audio frame) + TLEN added; all other bytes unchanged
method.cbr: audit/vbr_recover.py cbr: LAME CBR via lameenc 1.7.0, quality 2, bitrate = smallest standard >= max(128, 1.25 x source mean)
